newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, Hyperion connect networks.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, Hyperion connect networks.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp and Hyperion Telecommunications Inc on Wednesday said they will connect their telecommunication networks in New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Virginia.
This brings to 25 the number of interconnection deals signed by Bell Atlantic under the 1996 Telecommunications Act.
The act require regional Bells to open their local calling markets to competition before they can offer long distance calling within those regions.
However, a Hyperion spokesman said it had no local calling customers in Bell Atlantic's region yet. This agreement would help it to get into the business.
Hyperion currently provides mainly special access and point-to-point business telecommunications services, but does have local calling operations in Buffalo, New York and Jacksonville, Florida.
